statusText: Tail 13% (low), Stress 37% (moderate), Confidence 83% (high). Mapped policy state: EA_ON.
recommendation: Mapped policy state is EA_ON and Tail remains well below the block threshold. The narrow evidence-based danger window covers the U.S. cash open, 13:30-15:00 UTC, where an already-aligned bullish overnight regime carries the highest opening-continuation risk. headline: Nasdaq-100 futures extend to a new session high on oil relief and US-China summit optimism, with volatility still subdued
body: NQ front-month trades 30,204.50, up 0.96% and about ten points under the 30,214.25 session high after a directionally efficient advance from the 29,904.00 low. The 310-point (1.04%) range is modest and no failed-retracement sequence has been observed, so the advance still reads as an orderly one-way drift rather than a mean-reversion failure; the extension to a fresh session high since the prior hour is the single genuine amplifier and lifts Tail one point. Cash ^NDX closed Friday at 29,644.17, up 0.67%, at the top of its 29,371.89-29,647.80 range and about 3.6% below the 52-week high of 30,762.20. The impulse is benign and cross-asset supportive rather than stressed: WTI is down 2.64% to $97.65 in a fourth consecutive session of decline as Middle East diplomacy and Strait of Hormuz flows at six-month highs unwind the supply premium, while preliminary US-China talks ahead of Xi Jinping's Washington state visit on Thursday have been described by the U.S. Treasury Secretary as successful. Against that, the rate backdrop stays genuinely tight after the Fed's unanimous 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% on September 16: the 10-year closed Friday at 4.998%, up 5bp, and the 2-year reached a 4.743% cycle high before easing to 4.723% in early trade. That front-end easing alongside rising equities is mildly supportive rather than conflicting, but the absolute level of yields keeps Stress in the moderate band. VIX at 14.93 shows no volatility bid, and the shared Finviz cross-asset context was unusable this run (collection status partial, futures and calendar sections unavailable, and the file 172 minutes old), so this assessment rests on independently verified primary sources. The main conditional risk is the 13:30 UTC cash open, where an already-aligned bullish overnight regime is the configuration that has previously preceded opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry a published Claude assessment. Tail stayed in a 5-12 band and Stress in a 30-36 band throughout, with every slot mapped to EA_ON and green. Dominant mode was normal for 22 slots and turned trend-up in the final two, once the futures advance off 29,904.00 became directionally efficient enough to register. Tail drifted from 5 up to 9 between 22:00 and 01:00 UTC as the reopen set direction, eased back to 5 by 05:00 UTC, then stepped to 11 and 12 in the last two hours. Confidence improved steadily from 70 to 82 as overnight evidence accumulated. No slot approached the block threshold.
outlookSummary: The conditional path keeps Tail inside the low band across all 24 hours, peaking at 18 in the first full hour after the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open, where an aligned bullish overnight regime carries the session's highest opening-continuation risk, then decaying to 9 through the post-close, maintenance-break and Asian hours before ticking back to 11 at Tuesday's European open. Stress peaks near 43 at the open and eases to 32 overnight, staying in the moderate band throughout. Confidence declines with horizon from 83 to 66. Scheduled checkpoints inside the horizon are the 10:30 UTC Goolsbee speech and the 12:30 UTC Chicago Fed activity index; beyond it are Tuesday's Richmond Fed index with the Williams, Jefferson and Barkin speeches, the September 23 flash PMIs at 13:45 UTC, claims and new home sales on September 24, and durable goods on September 25. Xi Jinping's Washington state visit on Thursday and continued Middle East diplomacy around the UN General Assembly are the main unscheduled headline levers, with the trade-truce tariff cap expiring in early November still unresolved.
